description: This file defines a generic class AzureTableDataManager<T> which provides comprehensive CRUD and query operations for Azure Table Storage, including table creation, deletion, entry insertion, updates, merges, batch operations, and reading data, along with extensive logging and retry logic. It is scoped under various Orleans namespace configurations via compile-time directives.

classes.name: AzureTableDataManager<T>
classes.description: A utility class for managing Azure Table Storage entries with capabilities for table creation, deletion, entity CRUD operations, batch processing, and querying, designed for Orleans-based applications.

methods.name: InitTableAsync
methods.description: Initializes connection to or creates the Azure table if it does not exist.

methods.name: ClearTableAsync
methods.description: Deletes all entities within the Azure table.

methods.name: CreateTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Inserts a new entity into the table; fails if the entity already exists.

methods.name: UpsertTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Inserts or updates an entity in the table, overwriting existing data.

methods.name: InsertTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Attempts to insert a new entity; indicates success or failure if entity exists.

methods.name: MergeTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Merges data into an existing entity, updating specified fields.

methods.name: UpdateTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing entity using ETag for concurrency control.

methods.name: DeleteTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Deletes an entity from the table using ETag.

methods.name: ReadSingleTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Reads a single table entity by partition and row keys.

methods.name: ReadAllTableEntriesForPartitionAsync
methods.description: Reads all entities within a specified partition.

methods.name: ReadAllTableEntriesAsync
methods.description: Reads all entities in the table.

methods.name: DeleteTableEntriesAsync
methods.description: Bulk deletes a list of entities with specified ETags.

methods.name: ReadTableEntriesAndEtagsAsync
methods.description: Queries the table with optional filters, returning entities and their ETags.

methods.name: BulkInsertTableEntries
methods.description: Bulk inserts multiple entities into the table.

methods.name: InsertTwoTableEntriesConditionallyAsync
methods.description: Conditionally inserts two entities transactionally with ETag checks.
